upstream: R Core Team datasets package, original sleep.R source
transformation: 2026-10-06: reshape the two complete groups into ten rows using the original factor ID; no measurements changed, dropped or invented. Columns are increases in hours of sleep relative to control. Drug2 minus drug1 defines the paired difference.
licenseDelivery: Retain verbatim sleep.R, sleep.Rd, package description and complete R-COPYING with the separate derived dataset assets. R datasets metadata states Part of R; R-COPYING supplies GNU GPL version2. These assets and their reshaped data are delivered under those upstream terms.
origin: R help cites Cushny and Peebles1905 and Student1908. The help explicitly warns that group is misleading: these are measurements on10 people, not two independent groups.
limits: The teaching analysis is model based and does not establish a random sampling or randomized order protocol from these records. It is not a medical treatment recommendation. The source hash pins the actual observed numbers even though the upstream URL uses trunk.
